digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate documentation and packaged author guide
propositions: Author-facing guide must document that writers should de-risk risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe against real target) before committing to slow codified delivery loops such as CI/CD, IaC apply, or provisioning.
Packaged guide guidance must identify the new behavior as T15 and state that throwaway experiment teardown must be scoped only to resources created by that experiment.
Guidance must remain stack-agnostic without hardcoding Terraform, Docker, or product-specific mechanisms.
Registry module docstring, hand-authored gate documentation, and generated criterion-pins manifest must reflect the validated 44 criteria in the T1–T15 range.
